deliverables: Upgrade Cardano mainnet protocol to major version 11 and minor version 0
Remain in the Conway era with no era transition
Make new Plutus primitives from CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138 and CIP-0153 available
Make all Plutus built-in functions consistently available across Plutus V1, V2 and V3
Support case expressions for Bool, Integer and Data in Untyped Plutus Core

Enforce or tighten ledger and node validation rules including VRF key hash uniqueness, reference input rules, Constitutional Committee voting restrictions, withdrawals validation, and PPView mismatch reporting
request.what: Initiate an intra-era hard fork of Cardano mainnet to Protocol Version 11.0, named the van Rossem hard fork.

claims.claim: The action proposes upgrading Cardano mainnet from protocol version 10.0 to 11.0 through an intra-era hard fork that remains in the Conway era.

The upgrade adds new Plutus primitives defined in CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138 and CIP-0153, including modular exponentiation, dropList, BLS12-381 multi-scalar multiplication, Array, and Value-related built-ins.
The proposal states that all Plutus built-in functions, including newly introduced ones, will become available across Plutus V1, V2 and V3.
The proposal claims native case expressions over Bool, Integer and Data in Untyped Plutus Core will provide significant performance gains and cleaner script logic.

The proposal states that testing reports demonstrate no behavioral regressions, complete conformance between specification and implementation for new ledger rules, and correct operation of the new Plutus primitives and case expressions across Plutus V1, V2 and V3.

The proposal links to Cardano Node 11.0.1 performance results that it says show no regressions for standard value, Plutus and voting benchmarks, and acceptable baseline performance for new Plutus primitives and case expressions.
The proposal states that security audits have been undertaken for Plutus BLS primitives and execution costs for all Plutus primitives.

The proposal says at least 85% of stake pools by active stake should have upgraded to a node version capable of supporting protocol version 11 before ratification, and that this readiness must still be determined prior to ratification.
The proposal claims the governance action is consistent with all eight listed Cardano Constitution hard fork guardrails, provided attention is paid to HARDFORK-04 stake pool readiness.

The proposal states that reversion is only possible in extreme circumstances through the CIP-0135 disaster recovery process, while Plutus primitive use could be disabled by changing companion cost model settings if issues are discovered.

summary: The document requests a no-treasury hard fork to Cardano protocol version 11.0, presenting Plutus, ledger, node diagnostics and governance-rule changes, with several external references but limited in-document detail on readiness verification, audits, and concrete risk mitigations.
